title: ManagedCapabilityScopeV1

capabilityScope.description: Explicit canonical capability ceiling in an immutable accepted SpecVersion. Empty denies all effects. The Rust owner also enforces bytewise sorted order.

requiredCapabilities.description: Task requirements; every item must be present in the accepted SpecVersion capabilityScope. Empty denies all effects. The Rust owner enforces sorted order and subset membership.

capabilityId.description: Syntax only. Runtime canonical-ID validation uses arch_V1/contracts-v2/capability-registry-v1.json; aliases and unknown IDs are rejected. This design seed does not imply runtime availability or grant authority.

$comment: Capability IDs only define an accepted request ceiling. Actual dispatch additionally requires current Guard policy and a live authorized lease.
